trigger: single-envelope q adaptation, equal-opportunity environmental modes, and k-nearest prototype agreement all failed on the inspected 16-taxon development cohort
cohort: same 16 inspected Izu vascular-plant taxa; development-only
one_changed_layer: spatial aggregation scale of the existing NDVI state signal

retained_layers.set_selector: exact greedy maximum newly covered public land-grid cells
retained_layers.fallback: current_multiscale, q=1 pure geographic maximum coverage

new_derived_surface.ndvi_amp_mean250: the same existing NDVI p90-p10 amplitude averaged with the already-used ~250 m local window; this is a scale-symmetric aggregation, not a new ecological variable

support_area_control: for each q<1, every spatial view selects exactly the number of public-grid cells selected by the current_multiscale nearest-prototype q mask; scale changes only which cells are eligible, never support footprint

inner_selection.policy_family: all (scale_view,q) combinations for q<1 plus one q=1 geometry-only fallback
inner_selection.rule: within each outer-training fold and budget, evaluate every feasible policy on identical complete inner spatial folds and compute paired mean recall lift over q=1; if no ecological policy has positive mean lift, choose q=1; otherwise choose maximum positive mean lift
inner_selection.tie_break: exact ties prefer broader q; then current_multiscale; then point; then local100; then local250

controls.current_multiscale_fixed_q10: the strongest surviving low-budget development reference
controls.point_fixed_q10: raw NDVI p50 + amplitude with q10 area matched to current_multiscale
controls.local100_fixed_q10: ~100 m NDVI mean + amplitude mean with q10 area matched
controls.local250_fixed_q10: ~250 m NDVI mean + amplitude mean with q10 area matched

primary_question: can training-only nested selection of NDVI spatial aggregation scale recover a stable K5 ecological lift over global maximum coverage without hard-coding q or scale?
secondary_questions: does any fixed q10 spatial view beat the current multiscale q10 reference under identical support area?
which spatial views are selected across outer folds when inner data support an ecological constraint?
hard_boundaries: No heterogeneity, gradient, transition, WorldCover, terrain or microclimate feature is reintroduced.
No q, K, survey radius, thinning distance, or field endpoint is changed.
No additional spatial view is added after outer outcomes are inspected.
Outer-held-out coordinates are invisible until scale, q and all site sets are frozen.
Campanula field coordinates are not used.
Frozen 192 Practical Core taxa remain untouched.

If this family fails, retain the failure and stop within-taxon support-representation tuning; the next method-development layer must use cross-taxon development evidence or another independent training signal rather than outer-outcome retuning.
